answer: The 6 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. Because the basalt beacon is unpredictable until close, the pearl panel cannot be arranged, and the bridge audit records the draw inputs for every case. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
